settings.playback.dts_passthrough.description: Playback preference title: send DTS audio unchanged to an external receiver.

settings.playback.dts_passthrough.copy.value: Send DTS soundtracks unchanged to an AV receiver or soundbar on HDMI ARC/eARC or optical, which decodes them. DTS-HD MA and DTS:X play as their DTS 5.1 core. Used only while the TV's sound goes to that output; set Digital Sound Output to Pass Through.
